rationale: The remaining Biosync publication-link canonical INSERT is removed from the shared audiobook module. An independently authenticated QA private owner checks current staff audio.qc.review permission, active published ebook/audiobook versions, exact current manuscript and audio manifest identities, R2 timing manifest byte length and checksum, cue monotonicity, chapter duration bounds, and verified coverage before a deterministic idempotent fixed INSERT. The owner reruns source verification against its own primary D1 and R2; external callers supply neither SQL nor a positive rights grant. The two remaining commercial audio offline license mutations and playback telemetry retain exactly their original SQL/function identities, re-fingerprinted for the new source SHA. Production paid access and legal owner remain disabled.
